import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import App from '@src/response-apps/activity/newcomerTaskClaim/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 新人任务领取指令
 * 领取指定ID的任务里程碑奖励
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const uid = e.uid as number;

  try {
    const text = e.MessageText.trim();
    const match = text.match(/新人任务领取\s+(\d+)/);

    if (!match) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText('请指定任务ID，例如：新人任务领取 1');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const taskConfigId = parseInt(match[1], 10);
    const result = await App({ bid, uid, taskConfigId, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });

    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (result.code === 'INVALID_USER') {
      md.addText('请先踏入仙途');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    if (result.code === 'INVALID_TASK_ID') {
      md.addText('无效的任务ID');

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    if (result.code !== 'OK') {
      const failReason =
        result.code === 'OUT_OF_PERIOD'
          ? '您已过新人期，无法领取任务奖励。'
          : result.code === 'TASK_NOT_FOUND'
            ? '任务不存在'
            : result.code === 'NOT_UNLOCKED'
              ? '该任务尚未解锁'
              : result.code === 'ALREADY_CLAIMED'
                ? '该里程碑奖励已领取'
                : result.code === 'INSUFFICIENT_PROGRESS'
                  ? `${result.data.taskLabel}不足，需要${result.data.required}${result.data.unit}，当前${result.data.current}${result.data.unit}`
                  : '领取失败';
      const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, '新人任务领取', failReason, createBackendRequestContext(e));

      md.addText(failMsg);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const rewardParts: string[] = [];

    if (result.data.spiritCrystal > 0) {
      rewardParts.push(`灵晶×${result.data.spiritCrystal}`);
    }

    if (result.data.vipExpYuan > 0) {
      rewardParts.push(`VIP经验+${result.data.vipExpYuan}`);
    }

    const rewardText = rewardParts.join('、') || '无';

    md.addBold('【新人狂欢】');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText('任务里程碑奖励领取成功！');
    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(`获得：${rewardText}`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('领取新人任务奖励失败:', error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('领取失败，请稍后再试。');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
